watch.summary: The streamer wildly reacts and celebrates as 100T Asuna secures an incredible ace in a pro Valorant match.

beats.what: The streamer gets hyped as the replay graphic flashes 'ACE'.
The streamer counts out each kill in quick succession.
The fifth kill lands, completing the full team wipe ace.
The streamer pops out of his chair and points to his 100 Thieves jersey in celebration.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.why: This clip is focused on hype and excitement over a pro Valorant play rather than comedy. The streamer's loud, energetic reaction fuels the excitement, but it lacks comedic structure or punchlines.
